rules.statement: The construction of the mezzanine floor without the defendant- appellant's permission and the Mayor's approval was unauthorized.
rules.supporting_quote: (1) The plaintiff-respondent did have neither the permission of the defendant- appellant nor the approval of the Mayor when he constructed the mezzanine floor. (2) The construction exposed the plaintiff-respondent for prosecution by the Colombo Municipal Council. (3) The facts in the case show that the mezzanine floor is a structural alteration to the premises in suit, of a permanent nature. 139 Per Dissanayake, J., "Under the Common Law a tenant is entitled to carry out alterations which involved superficial or surface changes as opposed to permanent alterations." "A building is a structure and an alteration of a structure must be structural."
